This is selected evidence, not a complete CV. When summarizing examples, preserve their ownership qualifier e

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Get Alex Polonsky's current public opportunity status, preferred work and engagement contexts, and public contact routes. Preserve the structure: primary_focus is the main focus; other_paid_engagements are selected paid options; co-building or founding requires a clear commercial or ownership arrang

tools.name: get_post

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Private data: get_availability, list_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Private data: get_availability, list_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
